contract.rule: Pass this object—and only this object—to downstream inference.

customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam

Before any firm classification: My ceiling and the downstairs neighbour's ceiling are wet again; One plumber wrote that it is the cold-water line; another named a drain; The manager acknowledges the problem but has not arranged joint access; this is my fullest current account.

Regarding “recurrent multi-unit leak with conflicting contractor notes”, my first account covers: the leak source remains unresolved; for the request “coordinate evidence across the flats, obtain a technical cause assessment, and handle the official-deposit deadline correctly”: the information looks clear but leaves key questions open; on “recurrent multi-unit leak with conflicting contractor notes”, I feel stressed but will not rush; also unresolved: the affected units; that is what I know today.

My question is: coordinate evidence across the flats, obtain a technical cause assessment, and handle the official-deposit deadline correctly; in particular, I need clarity about the affected units and which detail must be confirmed before classification.

Before proceeding; I need a clear reply about the leak source; I do not want to act before this is clear.

My first note about it is dated 14 June 2025.

Ich kann bei Bedarf auch auf Deutsch antworten.

Yours sincerely
customer_message.subject: Please help me decide what to do: recurrent multi-unit leak with conflicting contractor notes
